summary: Banco Santander, S.A. filed a 6-K attaching a notice of redemption dated October 14, 2026, electing to redeem in full its Series 10 4.750% Non-Step-Up Non-Cumulative Contingent Convertible Perpetual Tier 1 Securities (CUSIP 05971KAH2; ISIN US05971KAH23), issued under a May 12, 2021 indenture with The Bank of New York Mellon, London Branch as trustee. All $298,400,000 aggregate liquidation preference outstanding is called at $200,000 per note plus accrued distributions, payable November 12, 2026; distributions cease accruing on the optional redemption date. Santander must pre-fund the full cash amount to the trustee. Watch refinancing economics and any replacement AT1 issuance.
